title: The free-streaming length of dark matter from JWST observations of 28 strong gravitational lenses
efc_relevance: Rules out CDM-departure for halo masses ≳ 10^7.2–10^7.4 M_⊙ — tightens the small-scale phenomenology EFC's L0/L1 regime must reproduce on lens-scale substructure; orthogonal to framework:FuzzyDM-Hu2000 and framework:SIDM-Spergel2000.
ledger_action: Add to Gap Analysis as small-scale DM phenomenology constraint; cross-reference framework:FuzzyDM-Hu2000, framework:SIDM-Spergel2000 and framework:SuperfluidDM-Khoury2015; required EFC consistency check at the 10^7.2 M_⊙ floor.
